original_prompt: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Deploy OpenTelemetry Collector
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    otel_version: "0.91.0"
    otel_arch: "linux_amd64"
    otel_remote_endpoint: "otel-collector.example.com:4317"
    otel_config_path: "/etc/otelcol/config.yaml"
  tasks:
    - name: Ensure required packages are installed
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name:
          - curl
          - tar
        state: present

    - name: Download OpenTelemetry Collector binary
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/download/v{{ otel_version }}/otelcol-contrib_{{ otel_version }}_{{ otel_arch }}.tar.gz"
        dest: "/tmp/otelcol-contrib.tar.gz"
        mode: "0644"
        checksum: "sha256:https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/download/v{{ otel_version }}/otelcol-contrib_{{ otel_version }}_{{ otel_arch }}.tar.gz.sha256sum"

    - name: Create installation directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /opt/otelcol
        state: directory
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Extract collector binary
      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
        src: "/tmp/otelcol-contrib.tar.gz"
        dest: /opt/otelcol
        remote_src: true
        creates: "/opt/otelcol/otelcol-contrib"

    - name: Install binary to system path
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "/opt/otelcol/otelcol-contrib"
        dest: /usr/local/bin/otelcol-contrib
        mode: "0755"
        remote_src: true

    - name: Create configuration directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /etc/otelcol
        state: directory
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Deploy collector configuration
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: otelcol-config.yaml.j2
        dest: "{{ otel_config_path }}"
        mode: "0640"
      notify: Restart otelcol

    - name: Create systemd service unit
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/otelcol.service
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=OpenTelemetry Collector
          After=network.target

          [Service]
          ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/otelcol-contrib --config={{ otel_config_path }}
          Restart=always
          RestartSec=5
          User=otelcol
          Group=otelcol
          NoNewPrivileges=true
          ProtectSystem=strict
          ProtectHome=true
          PrivateTmp=true
          CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target

    - name: Create dedicated service user
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: otelcol
        system: true
        shell: /usr/sbin/nologin
        home: /nonexistent

    - name: Set ownership on config directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /etc/otelcol
        owner: otelcol
        group: otelcol
        recurse: true

    - name: Reload systemd daemon
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Enable and start OpenTelemetry Collector
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: otelcol
        enabled: true
        state: started

  handlers:
    - name: Restart otelcol
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: otelcol
        state: restarted

---
# Template: otelcol-config.yaml.j2 (place beside playbook or in templates/)
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  config.yaml: |
    receivers:
      otlp:
        protocols:
          grpc:
            endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
    exporters:
      otlp:
        endpoint: "{{ otel_remote_endpoint }}"
        tls:
          insecure: false
    service:
      pipelines:
        traces:
          receivers: [otlp]
          exporters: [otlp]
        metrics:
          receivers: [otlp]
          exporters: [otlp]
        logs:
          receivers: [otlp]
          exporters: [otlp]
